summary: Steel lookout tower in Marion County, described by a 1953 federal survey and named on a 1972 USGS map; no source found describes the site today.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with a glass-enclosed house at the top (1953 survey description)
facts.status_note: No source read describes the site today; a federal survey listing codes the station's surface mark as reported destroyed.

events.note: Described by the U.S. Coast and Geodetic Survey as a four-legged steel tower about 50 ft (15.2 m) high with a glass-enclosed house

notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing or current condition found. Agency conflict is unresolved: the Central US Lookouts Arkansas index says Ouachita National Forest, while the tower's own page names the Arkansas Forestry Commission; the record and story use AFC. The NGS listing for GF0691 shows two rows (codes XX and NN) and no datasheet text, so the destroyed-mark code rests on one row. The 1972 map detail comes from Pastmaps' description of the map, not the map itself.
